parameters.name: BannedUsers
parameters.description: A list of users to mute. Separate multiple user IDs with a comma (,). You can specify a maximum of 30 users.

parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description:
The data center. This must be the same data center that you specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation.

> Currently, this operation is supported in Shanghai (value: cn-shanghai) and Singapore (value: ap-southeast-1).
